mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP level (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as corporate earnings growth follows.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods where GDPC1 increases.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% signals aggressive monetary easing, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 1.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary stimulus) and INDPRO (supply contraction) triggers a positive equity return as investors anticipate policy support for ailing sectors.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 1.5 and INDPRO < 102.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0), rising interest rates suppress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate strengthening labor markets, driving corporate hiring and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1600 thousand units (HOUST > 1600) signal robust consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of periods where HOUST > 1600.

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary regimes (UNRATE > 4.0), declining retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of periods where UNRATE > 4.0 and RSAFS declines.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in RSAFS (demand contraction) and INDPRO (supply shock) triggers negative equity returns as sectoral distress amplifies market volatility.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods where RSAFS < 520000 and INDPRO < 102.
